about: The beach grandstands, at every rung. Read by tools/stadium/build_stadium.py (builder venues/beach.py) to model the scaffold, and by scripts/bowl.gd to seat the crowd on its planks. Godot coordinates: x across the court, z along it, y up, metres. inner_half[0] is the front of each stand, BeachSpec.HALF_WIDTH + BeachCourt.STAND_SET_BACK. The -x stand is the one the umpire looks at all match, and is kept low so the sea stays in the picture.
